component_height.comment:
001) Input - Model
    Height of the component

component_width.comment:
002) Input - Model
    Width of the component

component_floor_clearance.comment:
004) Input - Model
    Floor clearance of the component

door_hinging_right.comment:
007) Input - Model
    Whether the door's hinges are on the right side of the door

hinge_hole_radius.comment:
021) Fixed - Model
    The radius of the hinge holes

component_thickness.comment:
003) Fixed - Model
    The thickness of the component

door_top_margin.expression: 1.72 in + if(door_wall_post_hinging; 0 in; if(floor_to_ceiling; top_notching_y_dist; 0 in))
door_top_margin.comment:
034) Fixed - Helper
    Distance between top-most hole and top of door

door_bottom_margin.expression: 1.72 in + if(( component_floor_clearance == 1 in ) and not(door_wall_post_hinging); bottom_notching_y_dist; 0 in)
door_bottom_margin.comment:
033) Derived - Helper
    Distance between bottom-most hole and bottom of door

door_swinging_out.comment:
008) Input - Model
    Whether the door is an outswing door

door_wall_post_hinging.comment:
009) Input - Model
    Whether the door hinges on a wall post

door_wall_keep_latching.comment:
012) Input - Model
    Whether the door latches on a wall keep

notching_x_dist.comment:
032) Fixed - Model
    The horizontal width of the notching

bottom_notching_y_dist.comment:
030) Fixed - Model
    Height of notching cutout from bottom of door

hinge_hole_space.comment:
040) Fixed - Helper
    Distance between the top and bottom hole on a single hinge

hinge_hole_x_dist.comment:
020) Fixed - Model
    Horizontal distance between hinge holes and edge of stile

hole_placement.expression: if(left_exterior_drilling or right_interior_drilling; hinge_hole_x_dist; component_width - hinge_hole_x_dist)
hole_placement.comment:
105) Derived - Model
    An offset that shifts the hinge holes to the appropriate side of the component

rabbeting_width.comment:
050) Fixed - Model
    The horizontal width of the rabbeting

rabbeting_depth.comment:
051) Fixed - Model
    The depth of the rabbeting

hinge_hole_depth.comment:
022) Fixed - Model
    The depth of the hinge holes

bottom_left_notching.expression: if(not(component_floor_clearance == 1 in); 0; if(( right_interior_drilling or left_exterior_drilling ) and door_wall_post_hinging; 0; if(( left_interior_drilling or right_exterior_drilling ) and ( door_wall_keep_latching or door_wall_post_latching ); 0; 1)))
bottom_left_notching.comment:
301) Derived - Model
    Whether the bottom left corner of the door is notched to accommodate the shoe on a stile

bottom_right_notching.expression: if(not(component_floor_clearance == 1 in); 0; if(( left_interior_drilling or right_exterior_drilling ) and door_wall_post_hinging; 0; if(( right_interior_drilling or left_exterior_drilling ) and ( door_wall_keep_latching or door_wall_post_latching ); 0; 1)))
bottom_right_notching.comment:
302) Derived - Model
    Whether the bottom right corner of the door is notched to accommodate the shoe on a stile

label_out_positioning_offset.comment:
107) Derived - Model
    An offset that repositions the "out" label relative to the door, to change which face is treated as the exterior"

label_in_positioning_offset.comment:
106) Derived - Model
    An offset that repositions the "in" label relative to the door, to change which face is treated as the interior

top_hinge_hole_1_y_value.comment:
401) Derived - Model
    Distance between top of the door and the center of the door hinge hole

top_hinge_hole_2_y_value.comment:
402) Derived - Model
    Distance between top of the door and the center of the door hinge hole

inter_hinge_gap.comment:
041) Derived - Helper
    Distance between top holes of adjacent hinges

mid_top_hinge_offset.comment:
042) Derived - Helper
    An offset applying to the mid-top hinge when the floor clearance is 1"" the door hinges on a stile

mid_top_hinge_hole_1_y_value.comment:
403) Derived - Model
    Distance between top of the door and the center of the door hinge hole

mid_top_hinge_hole_2_y_value.comment:
404) Derived - Model
    Distance between top of the door and the center of the door hinge hole

mid_bottom_hinge_offset.comment:
043) Derived - Helper
    An offset applying to the mid-bottom hinge when the floor clearance is 1"" the door hinges on a stile

mid_bottom_hinge_hole_1_y_value.comment:
405) Derived - Model
    Distance between top of the door and the center of the door hinge hole

mid_bottom_hinge_hole_2_y_value.comment:
406) Derived - Model
    Distance between top of the door and the center of the door hinge hole

bottom_hinge_hole_1_y_value.comment:
407) Derived - Model
    Distance between top of the door and the center of the door hinge hole

bottom_hinge_hole_2_y_value.comment:
408) Derived - Model
    Distance between top of the door and the center of the door hinge hole

door_perp_stile_keeper.comment:
011) Input - Model
    Whether the door latches on a perpendiculat stile

left_rabbeting_model.comment:
203) Derived - Model
    Controls rabbeting in model's left side as seen from the FRONT

right_rabbeting_model.comment:
206) Derived - Model
    Controls rabbeting in model's right side as seen from the FRONT

left_interior_drilling.comment:
101) Derived - Model
    Whether drilling is present the interior left edge of the door

left_exterior_drilling.comment:
102) Derived - Model
    Whether drilling is present the exterior left edge of the door

right_interior_drilling.comment:
103) Derived - Model
    Whether drilling is present the interior right edge of the door

right_exterior_drilling.comment:
104) Derived - Model
    Whether drilling is present the exterior right edge of the door

left_interior_rabbeting.expression: if(door_swinging_out and ( not(door_hinging_right) or ( door_hinging_right and not(door_wall_keep_latching or door_perp_stile_keeper) ) ); 1; 0)
left_interior_rabbeting.comment:
201) Derived - Model
    Whether routing is present the interior left edge of the door

left_exterior_rabbeting.expression: if(not(door_swinging_out) and ( not(door_hinging_right) or ( door_hinging_right and not(door_wall_keep_latching or door_perp_stile_keeper) ) ); 1; 0)
left_exterior_rabbeting.comment:
202) Derived - Model
    Whether routing is present the exterior left edge of the door

right_interior_rabbeting.expression: if(door_swinging_out and ( door_hinging_right or ( not(door_hinging_right) and not(door_wall_keep_latching or door_perp_stile_keeper) ) ); 1; 0)
right_interior_rabbeting.comment:
204) Derived - Model
    Whether rabbeting is present the interior right edge of the stile

right_exterior_rabbeting.expression: if(not(door_swinging_out) and ( door_hinging_right or ( not(door_hinging_right) and not(door_wall_keep_latching or door_perp_stile_keeper) ) ); 1; 0)
right_exterior_rabbeting.comment:
205) Derived - Model
    Whether rabbeting is present the exterior right edge of the stile

component_ceiling_clearance.comment:
005) Input - Model
    Ceiling clearance of the component

floor_to_ceiling.comment:
006) Input - Model
    Whether the door is a 3X86 Floor-to-Ceiling door

shoe_height.comment:
035) Fixed - Model
    Height of the shoe

shoe_door_top_notch_gap.comment:
036) Fixed - Model
    Height of the shoe

top_notching_y_dist.expression: if(component_ceiling_clearance < ( shoe_height + shoe_door_top_notch_gap ); ( shoe_height + shoe_door_top_notch_gap ) - component_ceiling_clearance; 0 in)

top_left_notching.expression: if(not(floor_to_ceiling and component_ceiling_clearance < ( shoe_height + shoe_door_top_notch_gap )); 0; if(( right_interior_drilling or left_exterior_drilling ) and door_wall_post_hinging; 0; if(( left_interior_drilling or right_exterior_drilling ) and ( door_wall_keep_latching or door_wall_post_latching ); 0; 1)))
top_left_notching.comment:
303) Derived - Model
    Whether the bottom left corner of the door is notched to accommodate the shoe on a stile

top_right_notching.expression: if(not(floor_to_ceiling and component_ceiling_clearance < ( shoe_height + shoe_door_top_notch_gap )); 0; if(( left_interior_drilling or right_exterior_drilling ) and door_wall_post_hinging; 0; if(( right_interior_drilling or left_exterior_drilling ) and ( door_wall_keep_latching or door_wall_post_latching ); 0; 1)))
top_right_notching.comment:
304) Derived - Model
    Whether the bottom right corner of the door is notched to accommodate the shoe on a stile

door_wall_post_latching.comment:
010) Input - Model
    Whether the door is keeping on a wall post
